active_family: state-aware normalized-innovation conditional law with one stochastic source and one shared generative core; first backend remains AR flow matching unless diagnostics justify a switch
single_framework_candidate_gate: A framework candidate must freeze one recipe and evaluate it on iv_only, anchor_only, and joint. Allowed differences are input/output dimensionality, support transforms, input heads, decoder heads, generic support-aware mixed discrete-continuous heads selected by one data-derived rule, and deterministic channel/group balancing. Scope-specific losses, loss weights, backend, prior, sampler, calibration layer, factor-name-specific sparse heads, or glued separately sampled decks are not allowed for a framework claim.
current_framework_status: 739a scorecard marks 734a as risk-manager-presentable under an explicit stress/conditional liquid-factor framing: IV scenario realism and risk-state allocation pass, liquid anchor and native joint realism pass, and IV-factor co-movement passes. 740a/741a falsify scalar IV sampling temperature as a strict-law fix; 742a falsifies a proper interval-score fine-tune as an immediate repair because it buys aggregate coverage by damaging path/level realism. 743a shows the stable IV hard cells have large train-tail/validation level shift, 744a shows the incumbent mostly misses the lower tail in shifted low-current-level validation windows, 745a rejects the cheapest scale-local prefix feature as a fix, 746a shows the incumbent passes train-tail coverage/distribution but still fails other strict gates, 747a selected state-balanced training as the next clean robustness falsifier, 748a rejects that state-tail sampler because it worsens validation coverage/level matching and also drops train-tail from 6/11 to 5/11, and 749a attributes the remaining bottleneck to multi-step transition/readout capacity rather than objective weighting, simple state prefix geometry, or validation shift alone.
normalization_policy: support-aware encoded levels; daily encoded increments; history-only fixed EWMA/RMS scale with robust floor; zero center remains the deployable incumbent. 679a/680a falsified full EWMA mean centering as too deterministic even with rollout-energy repair; 681a falsified EWMA drift as an added conditioning feature because it still over-amplified drift/mean-reversion and damaged level/path allocation.
backend_switch_policy: Do not switch AR/one-shot, flow/diffusion/copula, or Transformer/other backbone until required audits classify the failure as backend failure rather than data framing, reconstruction, conditionality, diversity, dependency, or distribution shift.
research_axis_policy: Change one axis per iteration unless diagnostics prove coupling. Axes: data_object, output_law, temporal_factorization, backend, encoder, dependency_structure, calibration.
literature_search_policy: Search papers/official sources during diagnosis when a failure class repeats twice, a methodology/backend/encoder/temporal switch is considered, a normalization failure is not understood, local fixes are exhausted, or model limitation is about to be claimed.
current_bottleneck: The model preserves one-day marginal realism and broad risk-state response, but fails to carry state-local directional tail geometry through integrated multi-step paths. Scalar widening, interval-score objectives, rare-state sampling, source-scale shortcuts, and simple prefix/readout tweaks have not fixed this without damaging path or level law.
last_result_summary: 749a compared 734a/742a/745a/748a validation scorecards plus 746a/748a train-tail and reran the 748a hard-cell audit. 748a hard-cell median low-tertile coverage fell to 0.095 from incumbent 0.316 and hard lower-miss median rose to 0.571 from 0.395. Objective weighting and simple state geometry are rejected as primary bottlenecks; validation shift is real but incomplete. The strongest attribution is insufficient multi-step transition/readout capacity.
